sections.description: Replaces the default WordPress dashboard with a branded Group6 client portal — SEO metrics, reviews, service CTAs, and how-to guides.
sections.changelog:
v0.3.10

  • Google My Business integration via Places API (New) — live rating, review count, and 3 most-recent reviews fetched automatically every 48 hours
  • Multi-location support — add multiple Place IDs and show stats combined (weighted average) or per-location
  • Competitor comparison table (How You Compare) shows client vs competitors with gap indicators and Google Maps links
  • Dynamic CTA automatically highlights the largest review gap; override with custom text in settings
  • Reviews widget redesign: stats, compare box, then 3 latest reviews always combined from all locations
  • Location labels styled as proper section headers with separator rules

v0.3.9

  • Login Screen Customizer — branded split-screen login layout with logo, hero image, colors, and custom error message
  • Login settings: toggle show/hide fields, WordPress media library picker for images
  • Disable Attachment Pages developer tool
  • CSS variable support in color fields

v0.3.7

  • Google Analytics 4 tracking script support added
  • Dashboard sidebar hidden when no tracking scripts are configured

v0.3.6

  • Responsive CSS fixes — widget grid uses intrinsic sizing (no media queries), header and card side padding reduced to 24px on mobile
  • Dashboard subtitle copy updated

v0.3.5

  • Client dashboard sidebar showing active tracking script indicators with hover tooltip
  • Settings redesign — Dashboard and Widgets tabs now use modern card layout
  • Widget visibility moved to Widgets tab with toggle switches per card
  • Content tab renamed to Widgets

v0.3.4

  • Beta update channel — enable beta builds from the Plugin settings tab
  • Auto-updater now switches between stable and beta Gist manifests based on channel setting

v0.3.0

  • Settings page redesigned with 5 tabs: Dashboard, Content, Tracking, Developer Tools, Plugin
  • Tracking tab: GTM, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, X Pixel, Microsoft Clarity — IDs inject scripts automatically
  • Developer Tools tab: G6 Asset Manager integrated (enable/disable toggle)
  • All new settings gated to Group6 email users only

v0.1

  • Initial beta release
